capabilities: save search queries as reusable template notes
run searches from templates using QuickAdd syntax with fill-in values
run a free search via a hotkey
display search results in the graph view
disambiguation: Not a note-templating tool like core Templates; the templates here are saved search queries stored as notes.
extras: The author asks for donations ('buy me a beer'). Templates are stored as regular notes in a user-chosen folder and stay editable.
intentEvidence: designed to ease your search experience within Obsidian
motivation: The author built it after repeatedly having to retype carefully crafted search queries whenever a new search replaced the previous one.
problem: Obsidian's search loses your query as soon as you search for something else, forcing you to retype complex queries.

relations.evidence: This plugin relies on the QuickAdd plugin to work its magic.
This plugin works wonderfully in complement with Vantage - advanced Search Builder for Obsidian.

summary: Search library that saves search queries as reusable templates and offers a free search that shows results alongside the graph view.
